correctness.rationale: Direct independent inspection of all 2^18 induced vertex subsets using component-edge count and degree <=2 yielded 49743 faces with the claimed dimension vector and 18-vertex/36-edge categorical adjacency; two independent rising/falling pivot orders gave exactly 24826 pairs, with all 322092 Hasse incidences topologically sorted and 16/33/36/6 critical counts in dimensions 6–9. Exact signed Morse projection produced 16x33 degree-7 differential with 19 unit entries and 16 private unit columns, and zero degree-8 and degree-9 maps, for both pivot orders. This supplies an integral unimodular rank-16 differential and hence Z^17, Z^36, Z^6 without torsion. One ordinary zero-cell and no dimensions 1–5 imply 5-connectivity; H_6=0 and Hurewicz yield 6-connectivity. Does not settle the full unstable homotopy type.
